name: rygentic-harness
description: rygentic-harness: all of the agentic tooling I use with Claude Code every day. Three plugins: mightymodels, vibe-code and python-harness.

plugins.name: mightymodels
plugins.description: Takes work from the first question to a merged PR: cheap workers do the reading, you make the decisions, and a task closes only when its commands pass. Built from the failures of spec-driven development.

plugins.name: vibe-code
plugins.description: Eleven skills for building, hardening and tuning Claude Code agents, skills, hooks, instructions, MCP servers, and loops, plus a vibe-code CLI that needs uv on PATH.

plugins.name: python-harness
plugins.description: Python engineering for Claude Code: eight skills (build-web-service, enterprise-design, design-persistence, design-tests, data-engineering, data-analysis, automate-task and tactical-slop-review), four agents (pylens, pep-talk, reviewer and test-engineer), the ty language server, standard-library docs on demand, and hooks that brief each session on the project's Python toolchain and a note whenever a Bash command runs plain python instead of uv run python.
